title: Advanced Musculoskeletal Injury Management

title: Sports Injury & Performance Physiotherapy
description: Sports injury assessment, athletic rehabilitation, taping and performance physiotherapy in Port Augusta at Nova Movement Atelier.
intro: Whether you are a competitive athlete, a weekend warrior, or looking to safely return to physical activity after an injury, elite sports-specific care is essential to get you back at peak performance.
sections: Why Choose Our Sports Physiotherapy Clinic?

items.label: Dual APA Sports Credentials
items.text: Surendhiran Subramanian has completed both Level 1 and Level 2 Sports Physiotherapy qualifications directly through the Australian Physiotherapy Association (APA). This advanced training delivers the gold standard in sports medicine and athletic care.

items.label: Advanced On-Field & Clinic Management
items.text: Our sports frameworks cover the full spectrum of care—from immediate acute on-field injury management and specialised athletic taping to comprehensive, long-term athletic rehabilitation.

items.label: Evidence-Based Athletic Progression
items.text: We don't just treat your pain. We build custom pathways that incorporate sport-specific biomechanical training, loading mechanics, and advanced strength and conditioning to make you more resilient than before your injury.

sections: Advanced Skills Taught in the APA Sports Framework

conditions.title: Acute On-Field & Emergency Care
conditions.focus: Rapid triage, diagnosis, and acute management of soft tissue injuries, joint dislocations, and trauma during live sporting events.
conditions.application: Ensuring completely safe, evidence-based return-to-play decisions on match days.

conditions.title: Advanced Rigid & Kinesiology Taping
conditions.focus: Structural joint support and neuromuscular taping for the shoulder, knee, ankle, and foot.
conditions.application: Utilising specialised taping patterns to unload vulnerable ligaments and tendons, allowing safe movement during rehab or competition.

conditions.title: Complex Joint Biomechanics (Knee, Shoulder & Ankle)
conditions.focus: Expert assessment of sports-specific mechanics, focusing on complex injuries like ACL tears, meniscus damage, rotator cuff strains, and severe ankle syndesmosis sprains.

conditions.title: High-Performance Strength & Conditioning
conditions.focus: Periodisation, exercise physiology, and tissue loading principles to safely bridge the gap between early clinical healing and high-intensity sport.

title: WorkCover SA & Occupational Physiotherapy
description: Occupational physiotherapy in Port Augusta, including workplace assessments, manual task assessments, ADL assessments and return-to-work programs.
intro: Navigating workplace injuries requires more than generic clinical care. It demands a specialised understanding of heavy industry, task mechanics, and structured return-to-work systems to safely minimise employee downtime and business liability.
sections: Why Choose Our Occupational Physiotherapy Services?

items.label: Elite Heavy Industry Experience
items.text: Surendhiran Subramanian brings a rare depth of industrial expertise to the region, combining 3 years of hands-on experience working with mining giants like BHP with a current leadership role as the Lead Physiotherapist at OneSteel Manufacturing.

items.label: Certified Occupational Expertise
items.text: Having completed Level 1 Occupational Physiotherapy training, our clinician operates at the highest standard of injury management, early intervention frameworks, and WorkCover SA compliance requirements.

items.label: Workplace-Driven Solutions
items.text: We bridge the gap between medical recovery and actual site demands. We ensure rehabilitation protocols mimic real-world industrial tasks, giving employers and workers total confidence during the return-to-work transition.

conditions.title: Workplace Visits & Ergonomic Assessments
conditions.focus: Comprehensive assessments of physical workspaces, office setups, and industrial machinery interfaces.
conditions.application: Identifying mechanical stressors, modifying environments, and optimising workstation ergonomics to eliminate repetitive strain and acute injury risks.

conditions.title: Hazardous Manual Task Assessments
conditions.focus: Biomechanical evaluation of high-risk tasks involving heavy lifting, awkward postures, or repetitive movements.
conditions.application: Delivering practical, engineered, and behavioural solutions to significantly reduce the risk of musculoskeletal injuries on the floor or out in the field.

conditions.title: Activities of Daily Living (ADL) Assessments
conditions.focus: Thorough clinical evaluations to determine how a workplace injury impacts an individual's functional capability at work and home.
conditions.application: Providing clear, objective reporting to insurers and medical panels to ensure appropriate funding and support pathways.

conditions.title: Gradual Return to Work (RTW) Programs
conditions.focus: Designing highly structured, progressive recovery timelines tailored directly to an employee's specific physical capacities and job restrictions.
conditions.application: Providing step-by-step physical conditioning to safely transition workers from modified duties back to full, unrestricted capacity without symptom flare-ups.

sections: Streamlined Care for Local Businesses & Workers

sections.text: Whether you are an employer looking to optimise your workplace safety or an injured worker navigating a WorkCover SA claim, partner with Port Augusta's leading industrial and occupational physiotherapy specialist today.

title: Geriatric Wellness & Healthy Ageing
description: Older-adult physiotherapy in Port Augusta for balance, mobility, falls prevention, age-related conditions and rehabilitation at Nova Movement Atelier.
intro: Maintaining physical independence, mobility, and confidence is vital as we age. Specialised geriatric physiotherapy focuses on optimising strength, improving balance, and managing age-related conditions so you can stay active and live safely at home.
sections: Why Choose Our Geriatric Wellness Clinic?

items.label: Advanced Clinical Frameworks
items.text: Surendhiran Subramanian combines advanced training in vestibular rehabilitation, musculoskeletal care, and hydrotherapy to deliver comprehensive, evidence-based wellness programs tailored specifically for seniors.

items.label: Proactive Fall Prevention
items.text: We address the key physical factors that lead to falls—such as inner ear balance issues, muscle weakness, and stiff joints—to restore your confidence on your feet.

items.label: Compassionate, Patient-Centred Care
items.text: We design gentle, paced treatment programs that respect your comfort levels, aiming to reduce pain and preserve your long-term physical freedom right here in Port Augusta.

conditions.title: Comprehensive Balance & Fall Prevention
conditions.focus: Identification of individual fall risks by evaluating leg strength, walking mechanics, and spatial awareness.
conditions.application: Utilising evidence-based balance exercises to reduce the risk of trips, restoring your confidence when walking on uneven ground or in crowded public areas.

conditions.title: Mobility, Gait & Walking Aid Training
conditions.focus: Assessing your walking pattern and ensuring your walking frame, stick, or crutches are correctly fitted to your height and physical capabilities.
conditions.application: Retraining safe walking mechanics to optimise your energy levels and ensure safe transfers in and out of chairs, cars, or bed.

conditions.title: Management of Chronic Age-Related Conditions
conditions.focus: Alleviating discomfort caused by osteoarthritis, osteoporosis, spinal stenosis, and chronic lower back stiffness.
conditions.application: Implementing safe joint-loading protocols, gentle manual therapy, and tailored home stretching routines to safely keep stiffness at bay.

conditions.title: Post-Surgical & Post-Hospital Rehabilitation
conditions.focus: Structured physical recovery following partial or total hip replacements, knee replacements, or prolonged periods of hospital bed rest.
conditions.application: Providing step-by-step guidance to rebuild lost muscle mass, safely restore your joint range of movement, and help you regain your baseline independence.

items.label: Hydrotherapy & Aquatic Exercise
items.text: Utilising pool-based therapy to entirely remove joint impact, letting you move, stretch, and build core muscle strength with absolute comfort.

items.label: Functional Home Exercise Plans
items.text: Simple, safe, and effective everyday exercises that you can confidently perform at home to maintain your cardiovascular health and joint flexibility.

items.label: Bone-Density Targeted Strengthening
items.text: Supervised, gentle resistance training customised to safely stimulate and protect bone strength for those managing osteopenia or osteoporosis.
